sources.title: Maternal age-related declines in live birth rate following single euploid embryo transfer: a retrospective cohort study
sources.claim: 1,037 single euploid transfers: live birth 54.5% under 35, 54.0% at 35-37, 41.7% at 38+; miscarriage 13.0%, 12.8%, 22.6% (not significant unadjusted).
sources.quote: Women aged >= 38 years demonstrated a significantly diminished live birth rate (41.7%) ... miscarriage (13.0% vs. 12.8% vs. 22.6%, P = 0.117)

sources.title: The impact of age beyond ploidy: outcome data from 8175 euploid single embryo transfers
sources.journal: Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics
sources.claim: 8,175 euploid single embryo transfers: implantation lower from age 38 (OR 0.85 at 38-40, 0.69 at 41-42 and over 42) vs under 35; factors other than aneuploidy contribute.
sources.quote: women 38 years or older had a significantly lower IR than those under 35 ... factors other than aneuploidy contribute to reproductive senescence

sources.title: Effect of Blastocyst Morphology and Developmental Rate on Euploidy and Live Birth Rates in PGT-A Cycles: A Retrospective Cohort Study
sources.claim: 4,172 blastocysts / 538 single euploid FETs: only trophectoderm grade A vs C differed in live birth; day 5 vs 6 vs 7 did not differ in euploidy or live birth.
sources.quote: only A grade TE was shown higher live birth rate than C grade (P = 0.024) ... the developmental rate does not associate with euploidy

sources.title: Day 5 versus Day 6 blastocyst transfers: a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical outcomes
sources.claim: Across all blastocysts (not only euploid), live birth higher after day 5 than day 6 transfer, RR 1.50.
sources.quote: LBR was also significantly higher after D5 BT (overall RR = 1.50 (95% CI: 1.32-1.69), P < 0.001)

sources.title: Recurrent implantation failure: a committee opinion (2026)
sources.claim: RIF defined after 3-6 failed euploid transfers; repeat uterine cavity/tubal assessment (SIS, hysteroscopy, HSG, 3D US); ERA, immune therapy, IVIG, endometrial scratch and routine sperm DNA testing not recommended for RIF.
sources.quote: RIF should be defined after 3-6 failed euploid-tested embryo transfers ... There is insufficient evidence to support routine use of ERA testing in RIF patients

sources.title: The use of preimplantation genetic testing for aneuploidy: a committee opinion (2024)
sources.claim: One SNP-array study found 96% positive predictive value; mosaic and false-positive results can occur; routine PGT-A for all patients not shown to raise cumulative live birth.
sources.quote: The investigators found the positive predictive value of PGT-A utilizing SNP microarray to be 96% ... some potentially viable embryos will be discarded because of mosaicism and false-positive aneuploidy
